card.title: PS4 Standby boot sequence and current draw troubleshooting

source.title: PlayStation 4 Standby Boot Sequence and Current Analysis

claims.statement: First stage +- 125 mA (from 23mA), Second stage +- 30mA indicates WORKING / GOOD
claims.evidence: Table row 1: First stage +- 125 mA (from 23mA), Second stage +- 30mA, Cause WORKING / GOOD

claims.statement: First stage +- 21 mA, Second stage +- 21 mA indicates Bad southbridge
claims.evidence: Table row 2: First stage +- 21 mA, Second stage +- 21 mA, Cause Bad southbridge

claims.statement: If it stays at 99mA with no boot it could mean that the southbridge is bad. Check the 32Khz crystal if it oscillates. If the 32Khz signal is missing, then replace the southbridge clean flux of the board.
claims.evidence: Table row 3: First stage +- 99mA, Second stage +- 99mA

claims.statement: If it stays at 7mA with no boot it could mean that the southbridge is not working or sending a control signal to the transistor
claims.evidence: Table row 4: First stage +- 7mA, Second stage +- 7mA

card.caveats: The image shows current draw stages and causes, but does not provide schematics for the southbridge internal logic.
